title: Walker reads notification_contract (reference-impl 0.7.3)
problem: The walker SKILL.md hardcodes claw-drive's sentinel tokens ([DONE], [NEEDS-INPUT]) and the watch-command idle threshold (--idle-after 600). Since claw-drive 0.5.7+ returns a notification_contract from start_session — carrying idle_after_seconds and a vocabulary array — these values could be read at spawn time rather than maintained as literals. Each past vocab change (CLV-64, CLV-74) required a coordinated manual sweep of the walker; a future rename or idle-threshold change would again diverge silently. There is no mechanism to warn the operator that the walker's dispatch table has drifted from what claw-drive advertises.
solution: Ship reference-impl 0.7.3 (additive, walker-only, no Standard change) with two surgical changes to reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md. First, immediately after the start_session call in step 5b, capture notification_contract.idle_after_seconds into IDLE_AFTER (jq fallback to 600 for older claw-drive versions) and validate that notification_contract.vocabulary contains both DONE and NEEDS-INPUT, emitting a stderr warning on drift but proceeding. Second, replace the literal --idle-after 600 with --idle-after $IDLE_AFTER in both the step 5b Monitor invocation and the step 5c resume Monitor invocation. A Notes-section paragraph (Vocab dependency) is appended to the SKILL.md Rules block documenting the dispatch-table dependency so future vocab changes surface at review time. One regression test case is added to reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts asserting the three text landmarks are present. Release-prep updates reference-impl/package.json to 0.7.3 and adds a CHANGELOG entry. The dispatch table itself remains hardcoded on [DONE] and [NEEDS-INPUT]; the validation block is the early-warning mechanism, not a runtime replacement.
acceptance_criteria: cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md step 5b captures notification_contract.idle_after_seconds into IDLE_AFTER with a // 600 jq fallback.
cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md step 5b validates that notification_contract.vocabulary contains both DONE and NEEDS-INPUT tokens and warns to stderr on drift.
cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md steps 5b and 5c Monitor invocations use --idle-after $IDLE_AFTER instead of the literal --idle-after 600.
cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md Notes section contains the literal **Vocab dependency.** paragraph.

1 new test case in reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts passes, asserting presence of notification_contract.idle_after_seconds reference, the EXPECTED_TOKENS="DONE NEEDS-INPUT" validation block, and the Vocab dependency Notes paragraph.
reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md contains a ## 0.7.3 — 2026-04-30 section describing the contract-aware walker changes.
Tag reference-impl-v0.7.3 is pushed, npm publish completes, and a GitHub Release is live.
out_of_scope: Standard schema changes. No new fields, no version bump on @cloverleaf/standard.
New CLI subcommands or lib files. SKILL.md prose change only.
role-based vocab dispatch. The contract has no role field; adding one is a claw-drive change, deferred.
wrapper_enabled: false legacy fallback. Walker always spawns with wrapper today; a no-token dispatch path is not justified yet.
Adopting notification_contract.watch_command as a string. Walker injects --since <last_seq> for resume semantics that the contract does not track; manual construction is simpler.
Rewriting the dispatch table in step 5d. Token names stay literal; the validation block in step 5b is the early-warning mechanism.
